title: Dropping a dragged pane near an edge splits the target there
body:
Dragging a pane (see `Drag::Pane` in `src/compositor.rs`) can only swap it with the pane it is dropped on. `State::drop` calls `Layout::swap`, which exchanges the two leaf ids in the split tree.

## Proposal

A drop near one edge of the target pane splits the target there and moves the dragged pane into the new half, using the same split as `Layout::add_transient`. The target's outline shows which half the pane will take while the pointer is over that edge.

## Open

- How wide the edge band is, in cells or as a fraction of the pane.
